Recovery and history

After-only failure-state evidence from deterministic local fixtures with simulated USB. These images prove presentation; real PostgreSQL service tests establish persistence/authorization behavior separately.

Actual Brother USB receipts

Actual Chrome UI and real PT-D610BT acknowledgements, with the Brother app closed. Development fixture API/history is local and identifies its test operator as Dev Staff. Physical acceptance comes from the user’s observations, not these UI screenshots.

What changed, and why

Durable operator history

Was

A browser-local receipt could not establish who printed an exact copy.

Now

Session-derived operator identity, immutable copy text/QR/unit snapshots and attempt/completion timestamps are retained in a dedicated server journal.

Safe recovery

Was

Partial or uncertain jobs required manual bookkeeping.

Now

Pending log writes never resend USB. Uncertain copies require explicit physical review; confirmed completed copies are excluded from linked continuations. Revision fencing and one unresolved browser job prevent stale or competing execution.

Whole-sheet checks and draft safety

Was

Display/export/USB ordering and browser draft ownership could diverge.

Now

One prepared queue drives display, CSV and USB. Whole-batch font/text/QR checks run before output. Account drafts expose save conflicts and provide Undo without dropping later edits.

Verification

  • 101 tests passed, including real PostgreSQL concurrency, idempotency, audit rollback, authorization, exact recovery lineage and migration checks.
  • TypeScript, touched-file ESLint, app build, Prisma validation, migration-prefix check, docs/codemaps and whitespace checks passed. Local Node 24.22; CI Node 22 remains a separate gate.
  • Browser recovery checks cover reload, physical review, remaining-only copies, log failure without replay, stale outbox, foreign accounts, corrupt journals, stop, changed media, Undo/conflicts and 1440/1024/768/390 widths; no page errors.
  • Approved body and battery PNG data URLs are byte-identical before and after. Necessary independent review found no remaining P1/P2 in the reviewed source.

Things to know

  • Local and uncommitted. Migration 0198 was applied only to a disposable test database, now stopped; no application database or production printed/applied state was changed.
  • This branch has no managed preview. Authenticated feature-route proof, application migration and separately authorized release remain open.
  • Each label is finalized and cut separately, producing one blank leader offcut. A lower-waste chained-print mode needs separately verified final-feed, stop and completion semantics.
  • Physical layout/scan, stop and between-job USB disconnect/reload checks passed. The test job was finished without printing its remaining copies and the pre-test sheet restored. No mid-transfer cable-pull or tape-out proof is claimed.
